description: Convert Unix seconds, Unix milliseconds, RFC 3339 or a YYYY-MM-DD date into normalized UTC forms. Use it to compare or store times from different APIs or logs; output is always UTC, with no conversion to other time zones. With from auto (default), an integer of 13 or more digits is read as milliseconds, a shorter one as seconds, and YYYY-MM-DD as a UTC date. Runs without network access and does not store your input. Returns input_format, rfc3339, unix, unix_ms, date_utc, time_utc and weekday; an unparseable value is an error.

l402_proof.description: L402 payment proof "<macaroon>:<preimage>". Omit on the first call; an unpaid call returns a 0 sat Lightning invoice and the macaroon. Pay the invoice, then repeat the call with this argument set.

name: timestamp_convert
